question: In which year was the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act passed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2005**__

• **The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)** was passed in the year **2005**.
